question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

Recent military purges, including the removal of senior Central Military Commission figures, have reinforced loyalty to his leadership, while appointments such as Cai Qi to key roles overseeing personnel and ideology signal preparations for continuity. With the 21st Party Congress scheduled for late 2027 expected to grant him a fourth term, no public indications of retirement or viable challengers have emerged despite economic pressures and his age. High-probability scenarios for removal before 2027 remain limited to unforeseen health events or abrupt internal shifts, though ongoing anti-corruption enforcement and elite network consolidation make such outcomes improbable in the near term.
